experiment: Bounded FFmpeg/TorchCodec ABI repair run: prefix preparation, empty-venv validation and one 60-second video GPU probe

root_cause.torchcodec_backends: torchcodec 0.15 ships one backend per FFmpeg major version (libtorchcodec_core4..core8); each backend dlopens the matching sonames libavutil.so.56 .. libavutil.so.60
root_cause.pyav_bundled_libraries: PyAV wheels bundle FFmpeg under hashed file names (for example libavutil-<hash>.so.60.8.100), so the dynamic linker never resolves the sonames from an av.libs directory; this explains the earlier failures when LD_LIBRARY_PATH pointed at PyAV's bundled libraries
root_cause.repair: unpack FFmpeg 6.1.1 Ubuntu arm64 runtime packages into a run-specific private prefix; libavutil.so.58 satisfies the core6 backend

ffmpeg_prefix.method: scripts/prepare_ffmpeg_prefix.sh: dpkg-deb -x of cached Ubuntu arm64 packages into a private prefix, soname verification, then a torchcodec import and AudioDecoder gate
ffmpeg_prefix.ffmpeg_core_packages: libavutil58, libavcodec60, libavformat60, libavdevice60, libavfilter9, libswscale7, libswresample4, libpostproc57 (all 7:6.1.1-3ubuntu5, arm64)
ffmpeg_prefix.blas_lapack_subdirs: present under usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu and added to LD_LIBRARY_PATH
ffmpeg_prefix.ld_library_path: prefix usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu plus its blas/ and lapack/ subdirectories
ffmpeg_prefix.torchcodec_gate: passed: torchcodec imported its FFmpeg backend and AudioDecoder opened the recorded video
ffmpeg_prefix.sources: device package cache only; no package downloads

env_validation.method: scripts/validate_realtime_environment.sh with FFMPEG_LIB_DIR pointing at the prepared prefix
env_validation.venv: new empty venv created with python3.12

demo_probe.method: scripts/run_demo_verify.sh in the existing Demo environment specified by DEMO_PYTHON, video mode, the same FFmpeg prefix, session cap 60 s
demo_probe.session: established successfully; ended at the 60-second cap
demo_probe.model_load: UnifiedProcessor initialization complete in 19.1 s; attention sdpa (flash-attn not installed)
demo_probe.model_text_excerpt: Chinese descriptions of the elevator scene, tracking the displayed floor from 21F to 24F

notes: All three stages ran in one bounded remote run; the driver scripts/repair_ffmpeg_and_verify.sh stops at the first failing stage and never retries or adds a second probe.

The empty-venv loop is now closed: with an explicit FFMPEG_LIB_DIR pointing at a prepared FFmpeg 6.1.1 prefix, package installation, pip check, torchcodec import, CUDA and WAV decoding all pass in a new empty venv. The earlier PyAV-directory attempts could not work because of the hashed library names.

The full Demo GPU probe used the existing Demo environment via DEMO_PYTHON, not the new validation venv; it used the same prepared FFmpeg prefix. Thus the Demo stack itself was not tested end to end in the empty venv.

Wheels and .deb files came from caches already present on the device. The pip index metadata cache had expired, so the torch installation needed one index fetch; that fetch was performed with the task's proxy variables cleared (the same run-scoped mitigation used in an earlier recorded run). Package downloads over the network were not otherwise part of this verification.

Earlier attempts in this session stopped before the probe for mechanical reasons (launcher path convention, a missing output directory, and the proxy-blocked torch install); each attempt that reached the FFmpeg stage passed its gate. No fix was retried in a loop.
This run does not replace the earlier successful video, audio-only, 30-second and 160 ms runs; environments and session caps differ and metrics must not be merged.
